events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: Seventy-five years young and still rocking! Chrissie Hynde's distinctive voice and songwriting have powered The Pretenders for decades. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Fifty-four years of pure rock 'n' roll attitude. Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your top tune from the Manchester icon?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on this day in the UK in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine The Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon released the iconic 'Imagine' album in the UK. A message of peace and unity that still resonates.

events.title: Apple released the first iPod
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The Gadget That Changed Music
angles.copy: Remember this? Twenty-five years ago today, the original iPod dropped, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. What's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering A Legend
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, universally known as 'The White Album'.

angles.name: 58 Years of The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles delivered a masterpiece: 'The White Album'. Which track from this eclectic double LP is on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the music world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in the UK in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Turns 61
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic journey. What's your standout track from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Forever In Our Thoughts
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose peace-loving spirit and timeless music live on.
